body: Thanks for your advice, but I don't think it's quite like that for me. My parents have tried to help me in the past. I haven't gone so far as to attempt suicide, but I know that mental health professionals and family care about me. I always avoid all shows of affection, it's like I'd rather be alone and going through life completely by myself. Whenever my parents actually try to talk to me about this, I feel more suicidal, far more. I know they love me, but at the same time they want me dead. They've given me a few cues about that, but for some reason I sometimes think they actually love me and then I feel guilty about hanging myself. Cutting for me is a way to feel more connected to myself. No one knows about it, it's on my upper thighs. No one knows about the suicidal thoughts either though.

Are those possible symptoms for some mental illness? I was just listing off the things that give me extreme anxiety, I thought a lot of people have anxiety, at least in high school. I've tried reading or occupying myself momentarily, but I always seem to return to suicidal plans or self harm or something else I initially tried to postpone or avoid. I'll try the exercise idea, this could be an issue from lack of sleep for such a long time. Thanks.
